acceptance.assertion: A correctly generated report-lifecycle artifact remains verifiable after the reviewed branch is squash-merged and the target commit therefore no longer has the branch source_revision as an ancestor; verification is bound to stable source/content evidence rather than accepting arbitrary ancestry loss.

The validator still rejects tampered generated content, mismatched provenance, unrelated source evidence and malformed or missing truth bindings; the fix must not turn source_revision_not_ancestor into an unconditional warning or bypass.
Deterministic regression coverage reproduces a branch-generation followed by squash-merge commit-identity change and proves both the valid squash case and negative tamper/unrelated-source cases.
After merge, the exact resulting weltgewebe main commit passes the report-lifecycle strict validation and the required CI/Docs Guard gates without manual regeneration outside the canonical contract.

approval.note: Unlocker for OPERATOR-ECOSYSTEM-REDUNDANCY-V1-T048 / Weltgewebe PR #1748. Fix only the report-lifecycle provenance contract and generated-artifact verification; do not weaken CI or unrelated workflow gates.

goal: Replace the ancestry-only truth assumption for Weltgewebe generated report-lifecycle artifacts with a squash-stable, content-bound provenance contract so GitHub squash merges do not invalidate correct generated artifacts while tampered or unrelated provenance still fails closed.

does_not_establish: permission to weaken report provenance validation
